card.name: Passive verbs before 'by' (prepared by)
card.fires_on: Past participles like prepared, created, made or obtained right after is/are/be, where 'by' plus a method usually comes next. Mostly in instructions on mixing or diluting solutions.

modes.label: Solution preparation
modes.description: The word 'prepared' after 'can be' or 'should be' in directions for making infusions or suspensions.

modes.label: Other made/created passives
modes.description: Passive verbs such as created, made or obtained that introduce how something is produced or calculated.

card.writes: It promotes Chinese words meaning 'take/put' (将, 把), which suggest a 'do X to the object' structure.
card.plain: It lights up on 'is prepared' or 'is made' just before the text says how something is made.
